# py2store

> Tools to create simple and consistent interfaces to complicated and varied data sources.


## Pages in this subsection

- [py2store](py2store.html.md): py2store: tools to create simple and consistent interfaces to complicated and varied data sources.

- [py2store.utils.mappify](py2store.utils.mappify.html.md): Utils to wrap any object into a mapping interface
- [py2store.utils.mg_selectors](py2store.utils.mg_selectors.html.md): Selectors that use the mongo-query interface
- [py2store.utils.mongoquery](py2store.utils.mongoquery.html.md): Transform mongo-like selector dicts (filters) into boolean functions that implement the condition
